title: Modules, source loading and reproducible projects
outcome: Separate namespaces from source files, execute a tiny owned multi-file project offline, and distinguish locked dependencies from code loading.

exercises.title: Use qualified access
exercises.answer: Qualified access works even without bringing the export into the caller namespace.

exercises.title: Trace exports
exercises.task: Explain whether export makes other names private.
exercises.hint: Compare name lookup with access control.
exercises.answer: Export controls convenient importing; module qualification is not a security boundary.

exercises.title: Inspect the project fixture
exercises.task: Identify which file declares identity and which defines twice.
exercises.expected: Project.toml declares identity; src/TinyScale.jl defines behavior.
exercises.hint: The test file consumes the source.
exercises.answer: Metadata, implementation and tests serve distinct roles.

exercises.title: Debug relative paths
exercises.task: Explain why @__DIR__ is used in the test entrypoint.
exercises.expected: It anchors the path at the source file.
exercises.hint: The process working directory may differ.
exercises.answer: Source-relative paths avoid hidden dependence on where the command was launched.

exercises.title: Design reproducible dependencies
exercises.task: List what Project and Manifest do and do not establish.
exercises.expected: They identify declared and resolved dependency state.
exercises.hint: Hardware, data and external services need separate records.
exercises.answer: A lock graph supports reproduction but does not alone qualify scientific outputs or service availability.

exercises.title: Transfer into a real package
exercises.task: Separate a CSV workflow into numerical core, IO and tests.
exercises.expected: The core takes values and returns values without network calls.
exercises.hint: Keep side effects at explicit boundaries.
exercises.answer: A pure public kernel is independently testable; IO and package operations can have separate integration checks.
